summary: Phase 17 is landed, green and committed: FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/PlusSlicedCertificate/Check.lean (737 lines) defines Certifies as nine clauses and synthesizes decidableCertifies from them, with each structural conjunct confirmed in isolation by example ... := inferInstance, and the checker RUN -- Probe.triv, the one-slice onePointCertificate at the empty context, satisfies all nine clauses and Certifies, by ten #guard lines that evaluate during the build (11 ms for the nine clauses, under 1 ms for Certifies). Three plan descriptions could not be implemented as written and each alternative is forced, not chosen: the existential side is stated on the position graph (TargetPathPos + a computed-liveness clause) because PlusFulfillingSeqLab is an unbounded existential over the integers and PlusLocalCoherentSeqLab reads lab (t +/- 1); the box clause is BoxLiveFaithful on live positions, NOT (C3) BoxFaithful on the slice labelling, because AgreesOnState pins the slab to a position's label only on the state shapes; and one clause was added, targetTime in winTimes, because the computed live set exists only at window times. forall_iff_win_succ, the combined-window fold with one step of lookahead, is a new lemma this phase had to prove from four new combined-period shift lemmas. The plan's second concrete certificate is NOT exhibited: at Fixture.cert the forward fixpoint does evaluate (fwdLiveT.card = 10) but a run that also asks for bwdLiveT.card did not finish in 7 minutes, and the full clause sweep including TailStable did not finish in 15, at a problem whose whole timed vertex set is 20 -- a fact about Nu.gfp's V.card+1 iteration count, not about decidability, and the reason Phase 20's risk row R2b should expect a hand proof rather than a #guard. Full lake build green: 2799 jobs, zero errors, zero warnings; sorry_count 0; axiom count 14 unchanged; INV fixed by --emit-inventory; four gate failures survive, all attributable to Phases 15-16 and tabulated at Phase 21's heading.
